findings.description: PyCrypto has been unmaintained since 2013 and contains unpatched vulnerabilities.
findings.remediation: Migrate all cryptographic operations to 'cryptography' (pyca/cryptography) or 'pycryptodome'.
findings.area_of_concern: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries
